presentation.description:
CatScan is a personal scanner for fates, B rank / A rank / S rank monsters, and epic fate bosses, with special features to help with recording hunt trains, S rank spawning, Eureka NM spawning and Bozja CE spawning.

CatScan does not contain networking features, and cannot alert you about hunts in other zones.
